_comment: Emberreach progression tasks. Objectives are evaluated against authoritative state only (PlayerData.stats lifetime counters or live inventory), never against session-local variables. Objective kinds: have_item (currently held), gain_item (lifetime), skill_level, mastery_level, kill_monster, defeat_boss, complete_dungeon, craft_item (lifetime, player-produced), do_actions (lifetime), reach_region, buy_upgrade, build_structure, gp_total (lifetime earned), unlock_pet, discover_items. Rewards are granted exactly once, on explicit claim. Difficulty (easy|normal|hard|expert|nightmare) drives the Tasks screen sub-tabs.

first_firewood.name: First Firewood
first_firewood.description: The survey stakes are in and the hearth is cold. Emberreach needs timber before it needs anything else.

notes: Unlocks the settlement ledger

hands_that_build.name: Hands That Build
hands_that_build.description: The first structure in a ruined settlement decides whether anyone stays.

notes: Settlement structures produce while you are away

cut_and_burn.name: Cut and Burn
cut_and_burn.description: Ash tells you what burned and where. Kilncraft is how the frontier reads its own history.

struck_iron.name: Struck Iron
struck_iron.description: Copper and tin sit close together under the ox pasture. Somebody has to go down and get them.

the_first_ingot.name: The First Ingot
the_first_ingot.description: The forge survived the ashfall. It has been cold since the last smith walked out.

an_edge_for_the_frontier.name: An Edge for the Frontier
an_edge_for_the_frontier.description: Holding a blade you made yourself is the difference between a settler and a resident.

objectives.label: Keep the scimitar in your stores

notes: Two bars per blade — stock Forgecraft inputs before you start a batch

the_longhorn_cull.name: The Longhorn Cull
the_longhorn_cull.description: The herd has gone feral and is trampling the survey line. Thin it out.

a_full_larder.name: A Full Larder
a_full_larder.description: Nobody holds a line on an empty stomach. Cook what you catch.

timber_for_the_walls.name: Timber for the Walls
timber_for_the_walls.description: The palisade is the settlement's first honest promise: you are staying.

notes: The Lumber Yard produces settlement Wood every hour

clear_the_road.name: Clear the Road
clear_the_road.description: The inland road is the settlement's only lifeline. The Cinderkin and the Sable Rooks both know it.

the_warrens.name: Into the Warrens
the_warrens.description: The Cinderkin dug under the settlement's old well. Find the Warchief and close the tunnel.

iron_blood.name: Iron Blood
iron_blood.description: Verdigris is a beginning, not a standard. The seam under the pasture runs deeper than tin.

proper_armour.name: Proper Armour
proper_armour.description: The Warchief's tunnel was only the first. Wear something that expects a second.

the_provisioners_ledger.name: The Provisioner's Ledger
the_provisioners_ledger.description: A frontier runs on coin as much as on ore. The provisioner wants to see the ledger balance.

notes: Storage is the cheapest upgrade you will ever buy

expand_the_storehouse.name: Expand the Storehouse
expand_the_storehouse.description: You cannot bring a frontier back to life while the shelves are full of the last attempt's leavings.

notes: Storage capacity is the first real bottleneck you meet

reedwrack.name: Reedwrack
reedwrack.description: The marsh took the old road and everything that used it. Something in the reeds has been restocking.

barrows_open.name: The Barrows Open
barrows_open.description: Hearthfall's dead were buried with their names on the stones. The stones are blank now.

bone_and_ash.name: Bone and Ash
bone_and_ash.description: The old rite is not superstition. It is bookkeeping: every name accounted for, every debt settled.

notes: Devotion prayers drain points per attack — watch the bar in the status strip

rest_the_dead.name: Rest Them Properly
rest_the_dead.description: Whatever is using the barrows as a door needs to be told, firmly, that it is not one.

field_medicine.name: Field Medicine
field_medicine.description: The apothecary's back room still has shelves, and the marsh has everything that used to be on them.

mastery_of_the_axe.name: Mastery of the Axe
mastery_of_the_axe.description: Familiar work stops being repetition once you can see the numbers change.

notes: Mastery shortens the action and raises yield — and it is per activity, not per skill

automation_multi_tree.name: Automation: Forestry Contract
automation_multi_tree.description: Two axes, one felling stand, and a contract to keep the yard fed without you watching.

notes: Automation is earned after the system is understood, never before

frostbound_reach.name: The Frostbound Reach
frostbound_reach.description: Above the treeline the ash gives way to wind. Something up there has been turning for a hundred years.

observatory.name: The Observatory of Gales
observatory.description: The instruments still turn. Their keeper has been waiting for a student and has very little patience left.

the_drowned_city.name: Nhalassar
the_drowned_city.description: A city that chose the water over the fire is still lit below the tide. Its ledger lists every name on the frontier.

catalogue_the_frontier.name: Catalogue the Frontier
catalogue_the_frontier.description: A settlement that knows what it has can decide what it needs.

notes: The collection log records every item, enemy and expedition

seat_of_the_herald.name: The Seat of the Herald
seat_of_the_herald.description: Where the ashfall was decided. Everything you have built is the price of stopping it.

objectives.label: Clear the Seat of the Herald

notes: Emberreach is rebuilt. The frontier keeps going — specialisations open up from here.

river_to_table.name: River to Table
river_to_table.description: The frontier needs a meal that does not come from a supply crate.

living_fields.name: Living Fields
living_fields.description: Plant the first dependable crop and give the settlement a place to grow it.

bows_for_the_watch.name: Bows for the Watch
bows_for_the_watch.description: Turn spare timber into a supply of arrows for the settlement watch.

leather_for_the_road.name: Leather for the Road
leather_for_the_road.description: Good clothing lasts longer than a traveler expects on the frontier.

runes_for_the_forge.name: Runes for the Forge
runes_for_the_forge.description: The forge can use more than coal when a scribe knows how to shape heat.

quiet_road.name: The Quiet Road
quiet_road.description: A courier survives by moving quickly and knowing when to leave unseen.

stars_and_marks.name: Stars and Marks
stars_and_marks.description: Read the night sky and call on a familiar before the frontier grows darker.

survey_the_ashes.name: Survey the Ashes
survey_the_ashes.description: Map the road ahead and recover what the old settlements left behind.

deep_veins.name: Deep Veins
deep_veins.description: The first easy seams are gone. Prospect deeper for what the frontier still holds.

flood_rations.name: Flood Rations
flood_rations.description: Long journeys need more than a first catch. Pack food fit for the marsh.

expedition_charter.name: The Expedition Charter
expedition_charter.description: The high-tier ruins demand proven strength and a completed dungeon run.

notes: Unlocks high-tier Expeditions after claiming

an_impression_remains.name: An Impression Remains
an_impression_remains.description: The old kiln is cold, but the beat of it is still in the brick. Listen long enough and you will have something to replay.

notes: Unlocks the way traces are threaded into racks

a_shorter_road_home.name: A Shorter Road Home
a_shorter_road_home.description: Two anchored places and a line between them. Nobody has to walk it again.

notes: Supplies other skills with contracted delivery

a_weather_you_can_bottle.name: A Weather You Can Bottle
a_weather_you_can_bottle.description: The mist is only cold because nobody has decided what to do with it yet.

notes: Vessels persist — a lineage is worth more than a single charge

somebody_has_to_do_it.name: Somebody Has To Do It
somebody_has_to_do_it.description: Repair evenings, seed exchanges, a communal oven. The frontier has plenty of work and very few habits.

notes: Established customs keep running without you

it_was_in_the_wagon.name: It Was In The Wagon
it_was_in_the_wagon.description: A gardener's seed chest, somewhere between the market and the estate. Start with what is certain and eliminate the rest.

notes: Tools unlock new methods, not just better odds

kindling_line.name: Kindling Line
kindling_line.description: A hearth is a contract: it eats kindling, and it promises to keep the frost out.

beyond_the_shallows.name: Beyond the Shallows
beyond_the_shallows.description: The shrimp nets have come up thin. Cast a little further out.

frame_and_flue.name: Frame and Flue
frame_and_flue.description: Before the smelter can breathe, it has to be built — and it has to be fed.

first_steps_on_stone.name: First Steps on the Stone
first_steps_on_stone.description: The obstacle course was built for soldiers. It takes apprentices too.

the_small_forge.name: The Small Forge
the_small_forge.description: Every blade starts somewhere; this one starts with borrowed bronze.

pasture_patrol.name: Pasture Patrol
pasture_patrol.description: Scrub fowl swarm the feed lines. The farmers will pay in eggs and gratitude.

grave_patrol.name: Grave Patrol
grave_patrol.description: The barrow watch is short-handed. Walk the rows; put down what walks between them.

cutpurse_apprentice.name: Cutpurse Apprentice
cutpurse_apprentice.description: The quickest way to learn a town's shape is to leave it quickly, and often.

turn_the_soil.name: Turn the Soil
turn_the_soil.description: Ash makes poor soil; patience makes it farmland.

runes_by_candlelight.name: Runes by Candlelight
runes_by_candlelight.description: The first glyphs are always drawn badly. Draw them anyway.

the_oak_line.name: The Oak Line
the_oak_line.description: Emberpine frames the shacks. Oak frames the future.

smoke_and_salt.name: Smoke and Salt
smoke_and_salt.description: Trout keep badly and sell well once smoked.

wrought_blades.name: Wrought Blades
wrought_blades.description: A frontier is only as sharp as its edges.

the_tanners_round.name: The Tanner's Round
the_tanners_round.description: Hides are honest work: nothing wasted, everything used.

hunters_moon.name: Hunter's Moon
hunters_moon.description: When the moon is fat, the barrow walkers grow bold.

the_rook_purse.name: The Rook Purse
the_rook_purse.description: The Rooks pay their marksmen well. Recover the payroll the direct way.

green_and_growing.name: Green and Growing
green_and_growing.description: Two crops prove the terraces work; the rest is arithmetic.

the_bone_offering.name: The Bone Offering
the_bone_offering.description: Old rites turn old bones into old favours.

star_charts.name: Star Charts
star_charts.description: Chart the lights before they chart you.

a_mule_at_the_crossing.name: A Mule at the Crossing
a_mule_at_the_crossing.description: Trade follows roads; roads follow whoever walks them first.

first_binding.name: First Binding
first_binding.description: A tablet is a promise a spirit agrees to keep.

the_coop_ledger.name: The Coop Ledger
the_coop_ledger.description: The roost's wards fail on a schedule, and the schedule is 'often'.

objectives.label: Clear The Plucked Roost three times

prospectors_due.name: Prospector's Due
prospectors_due.description: A claim is only as good as the coin it returns.

the_willow_debt.name: The Willow Debt
the_willow_debt.description: The marsh will lend you willow — at interest.

deepwater_contract.name: Deepwater Contract
deepwater_contract.description: Lobster boats go out further than the gulls like.

coal_and_steel.name: Coal and Steel
coal_and_steel.description: Steel is patience with a number attached.

knight_errant.name: Knight Errant
knight_errant.description: The castle's sentries hold a bridge nobody asked them to hold.

dragonwatch.name: Dragonwatch
dragonwatch.description: The valley keeps its wyrms; the watch keeps the valley.

the_long_hunt.name: The Long Hunt
the_long_hunt.description: A pack that hunts together gets hunted together.

mastery_of_steel.name: Mastery of Steel
mastery_of_steel.description: Familiar work stops being repetition once you can see the numbers change.

the_enchanted_tier.name: The Enchanted Tier
the_enchanted_tier.description: Enchantment is only jewellery that agrees to work.

temple_timbers.name: Temple Timbers
temple_timbers.description: A settlement that drills its watch and lodges its expeditions has stopped being a camp.

the_buried_archive.name: The Buried Archive
the_buried_archive.description: History is patient. It has been waiting under the ash since before the frontier.

stranger_tides.name: Stranger Tides
stranger_tides.description: The coast is quick to redraw itself in a season of storms.

the_forge_run.name: The Forge Run
the_forge_run.description: The Cinderkin keep their forge lit for the war. Tug on that thread.

mastwood.name: Mastwood
mastwood.description: Masts, beams and bridges: the frontier wants wood it can trust in a storm.

glacier_haul.name: Glacier Haul
glacier_haul.description: The cave lakes under the ice hold fish that have never seen a net.

the_silver_line.name: The Silver Line
the_silver_line.description: Silver and gold, out of the same stubborn rock.

skies_remembered.name: Skies Remembered
skies_remembered.description: The Observatory of Gales is never really silent. It just waits.

objectives.label: Clear the Observatory of Gales three times

the_umbral_gate.name: The Umbral Gate
the_umbral_gate.description: Beyond the gate, the dark is not empty. It is occupied.

drakesworn.name: Drakesworn
drakesworn.description: Drake-scale is worth the walk. The walk is worth surviving.

the_emberthrone_pilgrimage.name: The Emberthrone Pilgrimage
the_emberthrone_pilgrimage.description: The Kiln keeps a fire the Cinderkin consider holy. They will object.

blood_and_soul.name: Blood and Soul
blood_and_soul.description: The higher glyphs are not drawn. They are paid for.

the_stewards_charter.name: The Steward's Charter
the_stewards_charter.description: Wilds, managed properly, are simply a very old kind of infrastructure.

deep_echoes.name: Deep Echoes
deep_echoes.description: The deepest impressions are not of sounds. They are of habits.

the_umbral_standard.name: The Umbral Standard
the_umbral_standard.description: A banner cut from the dark itself, and the patience to cut five hundred more.

unmake_the_light.name: Unmake the Light
unmake_the_light.description: Some rites are forbidden because they work.

the_tidewrack_crown.name: The Tidewrack Crown
the_tidewrack_crown.description: Nhalassar drowned with its king still on the throne. Etiquette suggests correcting that.

objectives.label: Clear Nhalassar, the Drowned City three times

into_the_murk.name: Into the Murk
into_the_murk.description: The Murk remembers everyone who ever walked into it. Bring more people.

objectives.label: Clear Into the Murk three times

dusk_unending.name: Dusk Unending
dusk_unending.description: The Long Dusk does not end. It only pauses when its herald is put down.

objectives.label: Defeat the Herald of the Long Dusk 100 times
Clear The Long Dusk three times

the_heralds_due.name: The Herald's Due
the_heralds_due.description: The Seat of the Herald keeps a ledger of everyone who ever sat in it. The ledger is short.

objectives.label: Clear the Seat of the Herald five times
Defeat The Herald Ascendant ten times

a_purse_of_empires.name: A Purse of Empires
a_purse_of_empires.description: Coin is the only resource the frontier has never learned to make enough of.

the_whole_catalogue.name: The Whole Catalogue
the_whole_catalogue.description: A complete accounting of everything the Riven Frontier has ever produced.

forge_eternal.name: Forge Eternal
forge_eternal.description: The metal remembers every hammer. Be the one it remembers best.

splinters_and_sap.name: Splinters and Sap
splinters_and_sap.description: The splinter bins behind the sawpits are never empty, and never full.

the_oak_awakening.name: The Oak Awakening
the_oak_awakening.description: Oak is where the settlement stops being temporary.

ember_and_air.name: Ember and Air
ember_and_air.description: Fire is a tool that eats before it works.

objectives.label: Feed 15 oak logs to the kiln line

softwood_stacks.name: Softwood Stacks
softwood_stacks.description: Someone has to stack it before someone else burns it.

objectives.label: Add 30 Oak Logs to the pile

herring_shoals.name: Herring Shoals
herring_shoals.description: The herring come in silver waves; the smokehouses open their doors.

the_morning_catch.name: The Morning Catch
the_morning_catch.description: The marsh gives shrimp to anyone with the patience to stand still.

salt_line.name: The Salt Line
salt_line.description: Preserved food is an argument with winter, and it usually wins.

trout_terrace.name: Trout Terrace
trout_terrace.description: Trout live in the cold seams where the hills leak water.

copper_bottom.name: Copper Bottom
copper_bottom.description: Every frontier starts with a hole in the ground and a story about why.

nails_and_hinges.name: Nails and Hinges
nails_and_hinges.description: The forge's least glamorous work holds everything else together.

the_kiln_attendant.name: The Kiln Attendant
the_kiln_attendant.description: The kiln does not care who you are. It cares whether you brought ore.

tin_pannikins.name: Tin Pannikins
tin_pannikins.description: A helmet and a pair of gloves: the minimum kit for anyone leaving the gate.

cordwainers_corner.name: Cordwainer's Corner
cordwainers_corner.description: Leather is the quiet trade: nobody cheers for the person who made the belt.

shaft_and_plume.name: Shaft and Plume
shaft_and_plume.description: Arrows are planted, grown, cut, fletched and lost. Mostly lost.

mind_the_gap.name: Mind the Gap
mind_the_gap.description: The Glyphwell pays in runes and charges in attention.

waterworks.name: Waterworks
waterworks.description: Two runes, two temperaments: water soothes, earth endures.

hedge_hop.name: Hedge Hop
hedge_hop.description: The hedge run is short, and that is the point.

the_market_walk.name: The Market Walk
the_market_walk.description: A market is just a crowd with its pockets at elbow height.

early_harvest.name: The Early Harvest
early_harvest.description: Two herbs prove the terraces. The rest is patience and rain.

bitter_draught.name: Bitter Draught
bitter_draught.description: Every apothecary starts with one bad-tasting mixture and a shrug.

field_hands.name: Field Hands
field_hands.description: The farmhands carry loose coin and looser opinions.

kind_offerings.name: Kind Offerings
kind_offerings.description: The old rites do not ask for much. They ask regularly.

the_small_stars.name: The Small Stars
the_small_stars.description: Iridan is the courteous constellation: it waits for beginners.

quiet_marks.name: Quiet Marks
quiet_marks.description: The kiln keeps echoes of every fire it has seen. Listen politely.

wagon_claims.name: Wagon Claims
wagon_claims.description: Lost cargo, lost letters, lost patience: the work finds all three.

the_fence_line.name: The Fence Line
the_fence_line.description: The Cinderkin probe the fence every night. The fence needs fewer probes.

scout_duty.name: Scout Duty
scout_duty.description: Their scouts are fast, loud, and terrible at hiding.

rot_and_cinder.name: Rot and Cinder
rot_and_cinder.description: The shallow graves keep producing the same complaint.

herd_and_toll.name: Herd and Toll
herd_and_toll.description: Longhorn and raider alike: the survey lines must stay clear.

plucked_again.name: Plucked Again
plucked_again.description: The roost has been cleared before. It will need clearing again.

causeway_scout.name: Causeway Scout
causeway_scout.description: Something drags its feet along the drowned causeway. Go and be certain.

woodwrights_yard.name: The Woodwright's Yard
woodwrights_yard.description: Settlement rule one: saw the wood, stack the wood, build with the wood.

homely_labour.name: Homely Labour
homely_labour.description: Homes are the difference between a camp and a place worth defending.

objectives.label: Smelt 10 Verdigris Bars for the fittings

wanderers_ledger.name: Wanderer's Ledger
wanderers_ledger.description: Write down everything you find. The frontier rewards a good memory.

first_thousand.name: First Thousand
first_thousand.description: Coin answers questions that steel cannot.

the_ropewalk.name: The Ropewalk
the_ropewalk.description: Goldsmithing is a delicate business for people with calloused hands.

teak_wharf.name: The Teak Wharf
teak_wharf.description: Teak is the first wood that a boatwright will actually argue about.

the_burning_yard.name: The Burning Yard
the_burning_yard.description: Willow feeds the kilns; teak feeds the arguments about the kilns.

willow_baskets.name: Willow Baskets
willow_baskets.description: The marsh willows bend into any shape but a straight one.

salmon_season.name: Salmon Season
salmon_season.description: The salmon run upriver fat and certain. They are wrong to be certain.

the_long_line.name: The Long Line
the_long_line.description: Swordfish fight the line, the boat, and occasionally the boatwright.

herring_run.name: The Herring Run
herring_run.description: Herring arrive in numbers that make arithmetic feel like a compliment.

iron_drifts.name: Iron Drifts
iron_drifts.description: Iron is where the frontier keeps its promises: buried, and heavy.

the_coal_face.name: The Coal Face
the_coal_face.description: Coal is stored sunlight for people who work underground.

silver_seam.name: The Silver Seam
silver_seam.description: Silver threads through the deep rock like a rumour nobody can drop.

bar_stock.name: Bar Stock
bar_stock.description: The armoury counts bars the way misers count coins.

wrought_armourer.name: The Wrought Armourer
wrought_armourer.description: A matched set is a promise that nothing will have to be replaced mid-fight.

bows_of_oak.name: Bows of Oak
bows_of_oak.description: Two bends of oak, one string, and a very old argument settled.

quiver_filler.name: The Quiver Filler
quiver_filler.description: The watch fires iron arrows at problems that deserve bronze, on purpose.

the_silver_smithy.name: The Silver Smithy
the_silver_smithy.description: Jewellery is savings that can be worn to parties.

cosmic_drift.name: Cosmic Drift
cosmic_drift.description: Cosmic runes hum at a pitch only the very patient can hear.

chaos_theory.name: Chaos Theory
chaos_theory.description: Every chaos rune is a small, deliberate accident.

the_bitter_tonic.name: The Bitter Tonic
the_bitter_tonic.description: The second-tier draughts taste like the first-tier ones, only more so.

skilling_draught.name: Skilling Draught
skilling_draught.description: A good draught is a conversation with your own hands.

mole_pact.name: Mole Pact
mole_pact.description: The mole does not help. The mole allows.

trail_bound.name: Trail Bound
trail_bound.description: The trail run marks the edge of what a body can be talked into.

the_marauder_mark.name: The Marauder Mark
the_marauder_mark.description: Marauders keep their coin where their knives cannot reach. Usually.

chefs_purse.name: The Chef's Purse
chefs_purse.description: A chef's apron has more pockets than dignity.

lumber_scout.name: Lumber Scout
lumber_scout.description: The lumberjacks know the marsh routes, which makes them worth robbing.

ameria_dust.name: Ameria's Dust
ameria_dust.description: Ameria spangles even when nobody is watching. Especially then.

terra_watch.name: Terra Watch
terra_watch.description: Terra is the constellation of things that stay put. It is popular.

coast_claims.name: Coast Claims
coast_claims.description: A coastline is only a fact once somebody has written it down.

shallow_digs.name: Shallow Digs
shallow_digs.description: The first metre of soil hides the last thousand years politely.

medium_ground.name: Medium Ground
medium_ground.description: Sift harder: the interesting layers do not announce themselves.

sturdy_stock.name: Sturdy Stock
sturdy_stock.description: Essence from the sturdy veins is the first kind that does not evaporate.

dock_echoes.name: Dock Echoes
dock_echoes.description: The docks remember every arrival. Most of them wish it didn't.

freight_lanes.name: Freight Lanes
freight_lanes.description: Cargo does not care how it arrives, only that the manifest is right.

greenhouse_mist.name: Greenhouse Mist
greenhouse_mist.description: The greenhouse catches warmth the way a net catches fish.

bandit_trail.name: Bandit Trail
bandit_trail.description: The Rooks leave a trail of small mercies and missing cargo.

spider_teeth.name: Spider Teeth
spider_teeth.description: The fen spinners grew bold when the marsh grew quiet.

the_barrow_rush.name: The Barrow Rush
the_barrow_rush.description: Word went round that the barrows are open. The barrows heard too.

rook_season.name: Rook Season
rook_season.description: The Rook marksmen have a season. It opened the moment you arrived.

wraith_watch.name: Wraith Watch
wraith_watch.description: The barrow wraiths drift between the headstones like cold smoke.

the_long_sweep.name: The Long Sweep
the_long_sweep.description: Sweep the village edge to edge. Twice, for safety.

viaduct_run.name: Viaduct Run
viaduct_run.description: The Rook's viaduct is a toll road with opinions.

causeway_crossing.name: Causeway Crossing
causeway_crossing.description: Cross the drowned causeway until it stops objecting.

barrow_two.name: Barrow, Twice More
barrow_two.description: One clearance is a rumour. Three is a pattern.

objectives.label: Clear the Barrow of Names twice

quarry_works.name: Quarry Works
quarry_works.description: A settlement that mines its own stone stops asking for favours.

the_workshop_line.name: The Workshop Line
the_workshop_line.description: Workshop first, storehouse second: make things, then keep them.

collectors_instinct.name: Collector's Instinct
collectors_instinct.description: The catalogue grows whether or not anyone is reading it.

the_caravan_fund.name: The Caravan Fund
the_caravan_fund.description: A caravan is a promise that enough coin is in enough pockets.

yew_quarter.name: The Yew Quarter
yew_quarter.description: Yew takes eighty years to grow and one afternoon to decide about.

the_kindling_quota.name: The Kindling Quota
the_kindling_quota.description: The eternal kilns run on a schedule the trees do not control.

the_bark_market.name: The Bark Market
the_bark_market.description: Maple and mahogany move differently: one for crafts, one for statements.

swordfish_galley.name: Swordfish Galley
swordfish_galley.description: Galleys row out for swordfish and row back faster.

crab_pots.name: Crab Pots
crab_pots.description: Crabs are honest thieves: they take the bait and nothing else. The pots come up full and furious.

shark_drift.name: Shark Drift
shark_drift.description: The deep drift belongs to the sharks. Borrow it carefully.

mithril_veins.name: Mithril Veins
mithril_veins.description: Ghoststeel does not glitter. It simply refuses to stop being useful.

gold_reserve.name: The Gold Reserve
gold_reserve.description: The reserve is not a treasury. It is a very confident pile.

adamantite_claim.name: The Adamantite Claim
adamantite_claim.description: Skyiron is mined with respect. The respect is for the pickaxe.

the_mithril_forge.name: The Mithril Forge
the_mithril_forge.description: Ghoststeel plate is quiet work: cold, patient, and hard to flatter.

yew_bows.name: Yew Bows
yew_bows.description: A yew bow outlives its fletcher. It knows this and behaves accordingly.

green_dhide_full.name: The Green Set
green_dhide_full.description: A full set of dragonhide is a wardrobe that argues back.

blue_dhide_set.name: Blue Hour
blue_dhide_set.description: Blue scales catch the dusk in a way that makes sentries envious.

law_and_order.name: Law and Order
law_and_order.description: Law runes are the frontier's filing system for consequences.

death_watch.name: Death Watch
death_watch.description: Death runes are patient. They can afford to be.

eagle_eyes.name: Eagle Eyes
eagle_eyes.description: Bind eagles and owls: one for the horizon, one for the dark.

summit_air.name: Summit Air
summit_air.description: The summit run is where the hills admit they are mountains.

the_merchants_round.name: The Merchant's Round
the_merchants_round.description: Merchants guard their ledgers the way soldiers guard gates.

sworn_guard.name: The Sworn Guard
sworn_guard.description: The castle guard swear oaths, keep schedules, and carry purses.

sunken_digs.name: Sunken Digs
sunken_digs.description: What the water swallowed, the spade can negotiate back.

rich_depths.name: Rich Depths
rich_depths.description: The rich veins run thick and cold and slightly mocking.

frontier_sheets.name: Frontier Sheets
frontier_sheets.description: Mapping the frontier is mostly convincing the frontier to sit still.

master_charts.name: Master Charts
master_charts.description: A master chart is every argument about distance, settled at once.

cross_culture.name: Cross Culture
cross_culture.description: Blend two weathers and you get a third that owes debts to neither.

colossus_drive.name: Colossus Drive
colossus_drive.description: The colossi stand between the hills and everything worth crossing them for.

greyharrow_sweep.name: Greyharrow Sweep
greyharrow_sweep.description: The quarry exhales dust and grievance in equal measure.

echo_hunters.name: Echo Hunters
echo_hunters.description: The quarry echoes answer questions you did not ask.

golem_broker.name: The Golem Broker
golem_broker.description: Slag golems are slow, furious, and worth a great deal of XP.

castle_watch.name: Castle Watch
castle_watch.description: The Sunderhold sentries hold the walls. Relieve them.

glyph_patrol.name: Glyph Patrol
glyph_patrol.description: The Glyphbound Knights fight like they are reading your moves in advance.

deep_barrow.name: Deep Barrow
deep_barrow.description: Greyharrow Deep runs deeper than the quarry's maps admit.

den_breach.name: Den Breach
den_breach.description: The Frostfang Den is a hole full of teeth and weather.

brood_down.name: Brood Down
brood_down.description: The Broodweb Warren is less a dungeon and more a bad decision with corridors.

the_settlement_ledger.name: The Settlement Ledger
the_settlement_ledger.description: A settlement with an apothecary and a terrace of stars has plans.

the_buried_purse.name: The Buried Purse
the_buried_purse.description: Wealth on the frontier is mostly a rumour that refuses to die.

redwood_quota.name: The Redwood Quota
redwood_quota.description: Redwood is the frontier's answer to the question of bridges.

the_magic_number.name: The Magic Number
the_magic_number.description: Magic logs hum at the edge of hearing. The number is 75.

whale_road.name: The Whale Road
whale_road.description: The whale road runs where the charts end and the courage starts.

manta_shelf.name: The Manta Shelf
manta_shelf.description: Manta rays glide the shelf like they own it. They do.

adamantite_forge.name: The Skyiron Forge
adamantite_forge.description: Skyiron and Starforge bars in the same crucible is a very loud argument.

dragonite_smelter.name: Wyrmsteel
dragonite_smelter.description: Wyrmsteel is metallurgy that bites back.

jagged_runs.name: Jagged Runs
jagged_runs.description: The skyline run is a boast the legs have to back up.

storm_charts.name: Storm Charts
storm_charts.description: Charting storms is drawing pictures of things that resent being drawn.

the_cold_trail.name: The Cold Trail
the_cold_trail.description: Some cases go cold because they want to. Follow anyway.

ancient_digs.name: Ancient Digs
ancient_digs.description: The ancient layers are older than the names for them.

radiant_depths.name: Radiant Depths
radiant_depths.description: The radiant veins glow like they are being paid to.

perfect_echoes.name: Perfect Echoes
perfect_echoes.description: A perfect cycle is an echo with nothing left to correct.

confluence_work.name: Confluence Work
confluence_work.description: Condense the trade lines and the frontier condenses with them.

silver_shards.name: The Silver Shard
silver_shards.description: Silver shards are small mercies with excellent accounting.

hush_the_gales.name: Hush the Gales
hush_the_gales.description: The Tidal Reliquary keeps its calm the way a cell keeps its prisoner.

the_deepstone_descent.name: The Deepstone Descent
the_deepstone_descent.description: Deepstone remembers being magma. It resents the demotion.

voidwood_ledger.name: The Voidwood Ledger
voidwood_ledger.description: Voidwood grows where the frontier's boundaries were never agreed on.

herald_of_the_forge.name: Herald of the Forge
herald_of_the_forge.description: Herald metal is forged for the end of arguments.

the_eel_that_waits.name: The Eel That Waits
the_eel_that_waits.description: Abyssal eels wait at the bottom of everything, being patient.

umbral_harvest.name: The Umbral Harvest
umbral_harvest.description: Umbral essence drips from the deepest veins like slow, dark certainty.

the_quiet_throne.name: The Quiet Throne
the_quiet_throne.description: The last rite is quiet. That is what makes it the last.

throne_of_stars.name: Throne of Stars
throne_of_stars.description: Halcyon keeps the seat the other constellations defer to.

the_last_gate.name: The Last Gate
the_last_gate.description: Every road ends at a gate that claims it is the last one.

the_dusk_before.name: The Dusk Before
the_dusk_before.description: The Umbral Court holds its sessions at the rift's edge.

the_sword_hand.name: The Sword Hand
the_sword_hand.description: A frontier settlement is not built by hands alone. Take up the blade and learn what your body can do to a thing that fights back.
notes: Your combat skills rise only when you land hits. Fighting is how they train.

field_discipline.name: Field Discipline
field_discipline.description: Style is not decoration. A blade turned edge, a shield held high and a body that does not break — the three habits that keep you breathing.

consecrated_ground.name: Consecrated Ground
consecrated_ground.description: The dead are not gone, only interred. Bury what the frontier cannot use and the ground itself will hold a little longer for you.

objectives.label: Defeat 15 Barrow Wraiths with a prayer active

notes: Bury bones in Storage to earn prayer points, then light a prayer on the Prayers screen.

companions_in_the_field.name: Companions in the Field
companions_in_the_field.description: You are not the only thing on this frontier that has learned to work. Others have learned it too, and they will follow someone who does not flinch.
notes: Companions arrive through training, not purchase. Keep fighting the skill they favour.

what_the_tide_leaves.name: What the Tide Leaves
what_the_tide_leaves.description: Everything you kill drops everything. Half of it is slag. Learn to tell the difference before your storage fills with it.

objectives.label: Earn 25,000 GP in total from selling what you do not need

notes: Loot filters live in Storage. Untick what you do not want before a long offline run, and sell the rest to the trader.

warden_of_gales.name: The Warden of Observatory of Gales
warden_of_gales.description: Four seats, four wardens, and one blade in each hand that was not made by anyone still living. The Observatory of Gales has held its ground longer than the settlement has stood.
notes: The Wardens are the intended path to the four Godswords.

warden_of_tides.name: The Warden of Tidal Reliquary
warden_of_tides.description: Four seats, four wardens, and one blade in each hand that was not made by anyone still living. The Tidal Reliquary has held its ground longer than the settlement has stood.
notes: The Wardens are the intended path to the four Godswords.

warden_of_stone.name: The Warden of Deepstone Sanctum
warden_of_stone.description: Four seats, four wardens, and one blade in each hand that was not made by anyone still living. The Deepstone Sanctum has held its ground longer than the settlement has stood.
notes: The Wardens are the intended path to the four Godswords.

warden_of_embers.name: The Warden of Emberthrone Kiln
warden_of_embers.description: Four seats, four wardens, and one blade in each hand that was not made by anyone still living. The Emberthrone Kiln has held its ground longer than the settlement has stood.
notes: The Wardens are the intended path to the four Godswords.

the_marksman_and_the_adept.name: The Marksman and the Adept
the_marksman_and_the_adept.description: A bow answers at distance and a staff answers at range of a different kind. The frontier has both problems.
notes: Your style choice is real: the style you fight with is the skill that trains.

a_bounty_on_the_wyrm.name: A Bounty on the Wyrm
a_bounty_on_the_wyrm.description: Standing contracts, not wandering. Pick a target, kill it the set number of times, and the settlement pays out on the count.

the_pest_round.name: The Pest Round
the_pest_round.description: Farm and village both sleep better when something else does not.

flint_and_tinder.name: Flint and Tinder
flint_and_tinder.description: The easiest fire to make is the one somebody else already laid.

objectives.label: Feed 30 logs to the flame line

camp_bread.name: Camp Bread
camp_bread.description: Sourweed makes it keep; garum makes it worth keeping.

green_kindling.name: Green Kindling
green_kindling.description: Oak burns slow, which is a virtue on a cold watch.

purse_practice.name: Purse Practice
purse_practice.description: Start with people who will not notice, work up to people who will.

the_lookouts.name: The Lookouts
the_lookouts.description: Scouts count their own steps. Make sure they stop counting.

little_rites.name: Little Rites
little_rites.description: Bones are a currency the dead accept without counting.

the_potter.name: The Potter's Round
the_potter.description: Somebody has to make the first set that isn't falling apart.

six_small_stars.name: Six Small Stars
six_small_stars.description: Two constellations are enough to start a habit.

first_orders.name: First Orders
first_orders.description: The desk believes every case is solvable. The desk is new.

canopy_and_creek.name: Canopy and Creek
canopy_and_creek.description: Teak for the frames, willow for everything that flexes.

riverkit.name: Riverkit
riverkit.description: The salmon run upriver, and the smokehouses run short of salt.

hill_iron.name: Hill Iron
hill_iron.description: Ore and the coal to argue with it, moved in the same cart.

bellows_shift.name: Bellows Shift
bellows_shift.description: A blade drawn from your own steel is a bragging right with an edge.

the_quill_quota.name: The Quill Quota
the_quill_quota.description: A longbow and three hundred reasons to keep your distance.

gilded_trade.name: Gilded Trade
gilded_trade.description: Gold works harder as jewellery than as a promise.

runes_for_the_road.name: Runes for the Road
runes_for_the_road.description: Mind and cosmos: one for asking, one for the answer.

apothecary_second.name: Apothecary, Second Shelf
apothecary_second.description: Second-tier draughts: same bottles, better arguments.

trail_and_field.name: Trail and Field
trail_and_field.description: The trail run is the difference between a shortcut and a mistake.

the_cutpurse_route.name: The Cutpurse Route
the_cutpurse_route.description: Marauders and chefs: one keeps knives, the other keeps money.

sketchbook_season.name: Sketchbook Season
sketchbook_season.description: A season of coastline, converted into paper.

root_cellar.name: The Root Cellar
root_cellar.description: Roots and herbs keep a settlement alive between harvests.

the_watchtower.name: The Watchtower
the_watchtower.description: Drilled hands and a quiet roof: the settlement learns to watch its own edges.

objectives.label: Drill the Training Grounds to level 2

pit_and_purse.name: The Pit and the Purse
pit_and_purse.description: Bounty money spends the same whether it came from the ground or the counting house.

the_golbin_fair.name: The Cinderkin Fair
the_golbin_fair.description: Crowds make two kinds of work easy: blades and fingers.

the_fen_and_the_road.name: The Fen and the Road
the_fen_and_the_road.description: Spiders in the fen, rooks on the road. The middle of the frontier is crowded.

the_ember_oak.name: The Ember Oak
the_ember_oak.description: Yew burns like it has opinions about being burned.

glacier_icebox.name: Glacier Icebox
glacier_icebox.description: The cave lakes keep their fish cold and their secrets colder.

the_star_forge.name: The Star Forge
the_star_forge.description: Gold and ghoststeel share a crucible and exactly one opinion.

red_hour.name: Red Hour
red_hour.description: Red scale is expensive because the owners keep it.

black_hour.name: Black Hour
black_hour.description: Black scales catch no light and give nothing back.

storm_rations.name: Storm Rations
storm_rations.description: When the horizon turns grey, the kitchen turns serious.

the_pilgrims_kneel.name: The Pilgrim's Kneel
the_pilgrims_kneel.description: Terra does not move. That is the entire appeal.

ledger_and_ledger.name: Ledger and Ledger
ledger_and_ledger.description: Two ledgers, one road, no excuses left for a missing crate.

cask_strength.name: Cask Strength
cask_strength.description: Blend two weathers badly and you get rain; do it well and you get leverage.

the_bonesmith.name: The Bonesmith
the_bonesmith.description: Big bones first, small bones always.

quill_and_cudgel.name: The Quill and the Cudgel
quill_and_cudgel.description: The castle pushes, the road pulls back.

the_grey_court.name: The Grey Court
the_grey_court.description: Husks and echoes share the quarry like a bad parliament.

tithe_barn.name: The Tithe Barn
tithe_barn.description: A deeper apothecary and a taller farm: the settlement eats and survives it.

objectives.label: Terrake the Terrace Farm to level 3

the_underwatch.name: The Underwatch
the_underwatch.description: The viaducts and causeways belong to whoever walks them last.

objectives.label: Clear the Drowned Causeway four times

royal_fisher.name: The Royal Fisher
royal_fisher.description: Sharks and swordfish: the ocean's opinion of your net.

salt_of_the_deep.name: Salt of the Deep
salt_of_the_deep.description: Salt, fire, patience: deep fish demand all three.

redwood_beams.name: Redwood Beams
redwood_beams.description: Redwood hauls are measured in crews, not logs.

timber_of_nowhere.name: Timber of Nowhere
timber_of_nowhere.description: Voidwood was not planted. It arrived, and it stayed.

the_cold_smoke.name: The Cold Smoke
the_cold_smoke.description: Magic logs burn a colour that has no name in any ledger.

leviathan_line.name: The Leviathan Line
leviathan_line.description: A whale on the line is a horizon learning whom it belongs to.

skyiron_arms.name: Skyiron Arms
skyiron_arms.description: Starforge bars move through the forge like they remember the sky.

wyrmsteel_work.name: Wyrmsteel Work
wyrmsteel_work.description: Wyrmsteel is a furnace that has opinions about being fed.

the_radiant_field.name: The Radiant Field
the_radiant_field.description: The radiant veins glow like a rumour agreed to be true.

primeval_digs.name: Primeval Digs
primeval_digs.description: Primeval layers do not yield. They negotiate.

lantern_ascending.name: Lantern Ascending
lantern_ascending.description: Ashtar keeps a lamp for travellers who bother to look up.

the_last_fold.name: The Last Fold
the_last_fold.description: Condensing a trade line is diplomacy with a tape measure.

the_gilded_cask.name: The Gilded Cask
the_gilded_cask.description: A released programme is weather with a release date.

the_lost_legion.name: The Lost Legion
the_lost_legion.description: Cold trails are warm files that were left alone too long.

warden_repeat_gale.name: The Gale, Revisited
warden_repeat_gale.description: The Observatory of Gales has more arguments where the first ones came from.

objectives.label: Clear the Observatory of Gales five times

warden_repeat_tide.name: The Tide, Revisited
warden_repeat_tide.description: The Tidal Reliquary refills. So do you.

objectives.label: Clear the Tidal Reliquary five times

warden_repeat_stone.name: The Stone, Revisited
warden_repeat_stone.description: The Deepstone Sanctum settles. It never settles.

objectives.label: Clear the Deepstone Sanctum five times

warden_repeat_ember.name: The Ember, Revisited
warden_repeat_ember.description: The Emberthrone Kiln relights itself out of spite.

objectives.label: Clear the Emberthrone Kiln five times

the_unmaking_deep.name: The Unmaking, Deep
the_unmaking_deep.description: Unmaking gets easier with practice. That is the worrying part.

herald_bars.name: Herald Bars
herald_bars.description: Herald metal remembers being something else. It resents the demotion.

the_abyssal_tide.name: The Abyssal Tide
the_abyssal_tide.description: Lords and fiends arrive together, like an invoice and its interest.

murk_sovereign.name: Murk Sovereign
murk_sovereign.description: The Murk noticed you a long time ago. Now it admits it.

the_dusk_ledger.name: The Dusk Ledger
the_dusk_ledger.description: Every dusk owes the ledger an entry.

objectives.label: Defeat 300 Heralds of the Long Dusk
Clear The Long Dusk five times

drowned_crown_repeat.name: The Drowned Crown, Again
drowned_crown_repeat.description: Nhalassar's throne keeps refilling. So does its king.

objectives.label: Clear Nhalassar, the Drowned City five times

the_heralds_reckoning.name: The Herald's Reckoning
the_heralds_reckoning.description: The Seat of the Herald expects you now. Rude to disappoint it.

objectives.label: Clear the Seat of the Herald ten times

star_sovereign.name: Star Sovereign
star_sovereign.description: Halcyon's seat is the quietest throne on the frontier.

the_void_garden.name: The Void Garden
the_void_garden.description: Umbral veins flower once a century. Bring a bigger pick.

eel_sovereign.name: Eel Sovereign
eel_sovereign.description: The abyssal eel is patience with teeth, and the kitchen respects it.

the_quiet_road.name: The Quiet Road
the_quiet_road.description: The last gate is quiet because everything loud already stopped.

empire_of_coin.name: Empire of Coin
empire_of_coin.description: Eight million is no longer wealth. It is infrastructure.

the_complete_shelf_ii.name: The Complete Shelf II
the_complete_shelf_ii.description: Three hundred and eighty kinds of everything, catalogued and shelved.

the_last_page.name: The Last Page
the_last_page.description: Four hundred entries. The catalogue closes with a quiet snap.
